change_reason: Binance USD-M REST returned HTTP 451 for every symbol from the GitHub research runner before any economic result was observed. Signal, timing, cost, risk and validation parameters are unchanged; only the second venue is changed to Bybit linear perpetuals.
purpose: Test same-asset cross-exchange perpetual funding dispersion without directional price prediction.

signal.decision_information: funding settlements strictly before the decision-day open
signal.execution: decision-day open after the causal signal is available
signal.direction: short the venue with the higher trailing funding rate and long the venue with the lower trailing funding rate

economics.funding: actual historical public funding settlements while each perpetual leg is held
economics.price_pnl: actual open-to-open perpetual return difference between MEXC and Bybit
economics.cost_application: half round-trip pair cost on opening and half on closing; reversal pays both
economics.borrow_cost: not applicable because both legs are perpetual futures
unmodeled_risks: half-leg fill risk beyond stressed costs

evaluation.control: reverse the funding-spread direction with identical timing and costs
